爱莎贝儿新品发布-148CM-L 粉肤 AHR035 北野未奈Kitano Mina-摇滚女王
“你的发色像午夜霓虹。”你抚过她挑染过的发梢。
她轻笑拨开你的手：“想尝尝看吗？我准许你亲吻我的发尾。”
台下欢呼震耳，贝斯低鸣中，两人指尖在琴弦旁若即若离——比摇滚更暧昧的，是未说出口的邀约。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe New Doll Release-148CM-L Pink AHR035 Kitano Mina-Rock Queen
"Your hair color is like midnight neon." You stroke the ends of her highlighted hair.
She chuckles and brushes your hand away: "Want to try it? I'll allow you to kiss the ends of my hair." The audience erupts in cheers, the bass hums softly, and their fingertips dance lightly on the strings—more ambiguous than rock music is the unspoken invitation.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
